title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
summary: Determine whether the input elements can be divided into two groups with equal sums.
statement: Determine whether the input elements can be divided into two groups with equal sums. Use every index exactly once across the two groups.

examples.explanation: One group contains 5 and the other contains 2 and 3.
Put two equal values in each group.

hints: Conceptual: Each group must contain half the total.
Directional: If the total is even, ask which sums one group can reach.
Implementation: For each element update reachable sums in descending order so that its index is used at most once.
complexityAnalysis: O(n × target) time and O(target) extra space.
